Name: AgentIQ Azure Event Connector (Reader)
Description: Least-privilege, READ-ONLY custom role for the AgentIQ Azure Event Connector (MSP-B2). Grants exactly the three read actions the connector uses to poll Azure Monitor Alerts, Activity Log administrative events, and Service Health events. No write, delete, management, metrics, Log Analytics, diagnostic-log, Defender, or Sentinel permissions. Works for both Azure Lighthouse delegated access and direct per-subscription assignment; identical in AzureCloud and AzureUSGovernment. Replace the AssignableScopes placeholder with the target subscription id(s) before creating the role.
